label: daily-level-filter-aligned
description: Level filtering as Grafana Explore and Logs Drilldown send it, on data that carries a stored level and on data whose level is only in the line: detected_level equals, regexp, not-equal and unknown forms on log queries, Drilldown's service logs with a level pill, its logs volume by level (with and without the pill), field and label breakdowns under a level filter before | json, level filters after | json and | logfmt, metrics by detected_level, rate, topk, and keep or drop of the level labels. Every answer is non-empty on both seeds, so run it on the default stack and again with --no-level-label (README, Rows with no stored level); the unknown forms (LF4, LF19) put the no-level rows under data on the second run.
